lines.line: Hmm?
Is there anything I can help you with?
Nah. I don't think so.
Don't bother me, peasant. I've had a long journey and paid too much coin on these gifts to be late to Vittoria's wedding.
Enjoy the wedding.
Indeed. If we ever get there.
Loyal Nords are always welcome here. Anyone else better watch their step.
If I were you, I'd keep away from the barrow on the east side of town... it's haunted.
I'd like to rent a room. (10 gold)
Sure thing. It's yours for a day.
If there are five hundred steps to each marker then maybe...Argh! This is pointless. Dar'Rakki can not rely on shortcuts!
Any thoughts on the townsfolk?
This is a good place to hide one's identity, no? Ivarstead attracts those who cling to lofty ideals. They never suspect our faces are two.
You see those warriors from Hammerfell? They've got curved swords. Curved. Swords.
What do you play?
I play the lute. If you'd like to hear something, it only costs five gold.
This has to be the worst place in Skyrim to run a mill. How am I supposed to do anything with all those bears running around?
What's making you so angry?
My business is falling apart, my apprentice never listens to me and now there's talk of dragons.
If I hadn't sunk every bit of gold I had into my mill, I would have picked up and left Ivarstead long ago.
You want a drink?
What's on the menu?
Depends. Are you thirsty, hungry, both?
Anything you can tell me about High Hrothgar?
I've always fancied a journey up the 7,000 Steps to the monastery.
Anything to break the boredom of living in this town. I envy you.
Need something?
All right, hand over your valuables, or I'll gut you like a fish.
Walk away. Right now. (Intimidate)
Nice try, but you don't scare me.
I'm not going to ask again.
I'd rather die!
Then I guess that's your last request, fool!
Hmph.
What have you got for sale?
Take a look.
Yes?
And what might you need? Hmm?
Is there anything I can help you with?
Nah. I don't think so.
Looking for my husband Nazeem? Check the Jarl's backside. That's usually where he stuffs himself these days.
Is there anything I can help you with?
Maybe you can help me.
What do you need?
Of course.
Of course.
Of course.
It's all in this note.
Never been to Whiterun before? The Jarl's palace is something to see. Big old dragon skull hanging on the wall. Impressive.
What do you know about Whiterun?
Well, I know the Companions make their home here. Their mead hall, Jorrvaskr, is the oldest building in the city.
Oh, and there's a nasty feud between two families called the Gray-Manes and the Battle-Borns. You'll want to be careful there.
The rest you can find out by asking the townsfolk. I'd start with the barkeep at the Bannered Mare, or the castle Steward.
Think you can go blade to blade with me? You'd be dead in six seconds.
You think you can take me on?
And why not? I could beat anyone in this city, bare-handed.
A hundred gold says I knock your hide to the ground.
I've got better things to do.
Pfft. Snowback.
You must really love to fight.
The heat of the battle is the fire that forges the strongest blades. It's an old Nord proverb.
That, and a true Nord never misses a chance to test her worth.
Sounds like you've got a grudge.
You been talking to those Companions?
"Too hot-headed," they cried. Weak, pathetic cowards, the lot of them!
Why'd the Companions reject you?
It wasn't my fault! I told them over and over that it was an accident!
They wanted me to prove my worth, so they threw me up against a young whelp of a lad, hardly old enough to grow his first chin hairs.
I guess they thought a woman wasn't strong enough to hurt him. I didn't mean for him to die! Why would I want that? I just... I just lost control.
Want to hear a little Nord wisdom? You don't really know a woman 'til you've had a strong drink and a fistfight with her.
You think you can take me on?
And why not? I could beat anyone in this city, bare-handed.
A hundred gold says I knock your hide to the ground.
You're on. (Brawl - 100 gold)
Just fists. No weapons, no magic... no crying. Let's go!
Now that's what I call a punch. You got me.
I think I've earned that 100 gold.
You're no liar. Best fight I've had in years. There you are.
If you ever need another blade at your side, just ask. Wouldn't mind seeing how you handle a few trolls.
Ain't every day we get visitors in Riverwood.
Need any help around the forge?
Yes, actually. How about you smith me an iron dagger? Here's everything you need to make one. Go ahead.
Whatever you need. By Ysmir, if it's simple and strong, I can forge it.
Here's an iron dagger.
Not bad, but it's a little dull. How about you sharpen it up? Just need a bit of metal and the grindstone over there.
